name: Atari 5200 SuperSystem
significance: Offered unprecedented home arcade graphical fidelity, though burdened by non-centering analog controllers and ill timing amidst the 1983 crash.

editorialContent.overview: Atari's powerful high-end console derived from its 8-bit computer architecture, featuring early 360-degree analog joysticks.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Offered unprecedented home arcade graphical fidelity, though burdened by non-centering analog controllers and ill timing amidst the 1983 crash.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: Analog 360-degree joystick with 12-key numeric pad and dual fire buttons
